BWAPI. identity. BWAPI, Brood War API, Brood War Application Programming Interface, BWAPI programming API, BWAPI development framework, BWAPI packaged opponent distinction. Outside research: BWAPI is a free, open-source C++ framework for creating AI agents that interact with StarCraft: Brood War. It is a programming API, not a prepackaged opponent client.

BWAPI quick-start version. compatibility. BWAPI 1.16.1, BWAPI Remastered, BWAPI developer quick-start version, BWAPI quick start target edition. Outside research: the reviewed BWAPI README quick start specifies Brood War 1.16.1. That does not certify arbitrary BWAPI binaries for Remastered.

BWAPI example launch route. installation. BWAPI Chaoslauncher, BWAPI ExampleAIModule, BWAPI developer setup, BWAPI developer example launch, BWAPI release injector, BWAPI example module destination. Outside research: BWAPI’s example quick start builds a release ExampleAIModule.dll, copies it into bwapi-data/AI, then runs StarCraft through Chaoslauncher with the release injector enabled. These developer steps are separate from the SCM map setup.

BWAPI information defaults. features. BWAPI cheating, BWAPI fog of war, BWAPI human input, BWAPI visible-state restrictions, BWAPI default human control restrictions, BWAPI tournament settings. Outside research: BWAPI normally hides units outside visible game state and blocks human unit control; tournament modules can enforce settings. Changed defaults are announced, so this is not a guarantee that every bot uses identical restrictions.

BWAPI releases. download. BWAPI download, BWAPI release link, BWAPI SDK, BWAPI developer downloads, BWAPI SDK releases. Outside research: the BWAPI README links its GitHub Releases for developer downloads. A release asset is different from the guide’s integrated SCM map archive.

UAlbertaBot. identity. UAlbertaBot, U Alberta Bot, UAB, UAlbertaBot competition AI. Outside research: UAlbertaBot is David Churchill’s StarCraft AI competition bot. Its repository directs readers to the wiki for full setup documentation.

Outside research: UAlbertaBot’s README and official wiki identify David Churchill. PurpleWave. identity. PurpleWave, Purple Wave, PurpleWave bot, PurpleWave Scala bot, PurpleWave supported races. Outside research: PurpleWave is a Scala AI bot for Brood War that can play all three races. It is a separately documented bot, not the guide’s integrated Remastered map.

Outside research: PurpleWave’s reviewed README requires a 32-bit JDK 8 at runtime because it connects to 32-bit BWAPI. Do not substitute the guide’s SCHNAIL Java 21 recommendation.

Outside research: PurpleWave’s README uses Maven with initialized submodules; mvn clean package produces target/PurpleWave-1.0.jar. This is source-build guidance, not a prebuilt-download promise.

Steamhammer. identity. Steamhammer, Steam hammer, Steamhammer bot, Steamhammer parent bot, Steamhammer bot lineage, Steamhammer descendant. Outside research: Steamhammer is a BWAPI bot for Brood War descended from Dave Churchill’s UAlbertaBot. Its maintainer page describes it as a starter bot capable of all three races.

Steamhammer attribution conflict. creator. Steamhammer creator, who made Steamhammer, Steamhammer author, Steamhammer maintainer attribution, Steamhammer Jay Scott attribution. The guide credits Steamhammer to Dave Churchill. Outside research: Steamhammer’s maintainer page is signed Jay Scott and identifies Churchill’s UAlbertaBot as its parent. Treat the guide’s creator attribution as conflicting, not established authorship.

Steamhammer configuration, Steamhammer JSON, Steamhammer BWAPI version, Steamhammer binary configuration destination, Steamhammer JSON placement, Steamhammer matching JSON configuration, Steamhammer binary API version. Steamhammer lineage and license. features. Steamhammer license, Steamhammer UAlbertaBot relationship, Steamhammer inherited license, Steamhammer MIT license, Steamhammer parent relationship.
